headline: Every container of flavour checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and visit to Carrum Downs
heroLede: Strawberry and raspberry look the same in a white container, so the label is what your customer relies on. Here's what a camera check could look like on your filling line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every container has its cap on, straight and fully closed. A loose cap means a leak in transit and a claim from the customer.
labelLede: Strawberry and raspberry look the same in a white container. The camera checks every container carries the right label for the flavour inside, straight and intact, so your customer never gets the wrong flavour or a wrong organic claim.
codeLede: Your customers trace every ingredient by batch. The system reads the printed batch and best-before code on every container and compares it with the flavour and batch set at changeover.
objectLede: Cap offcuts, label backing and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.alert: Four crooked caps in fifteen minutes. Check the capper.
